# Test fixture for `xengine keyproof -seed` (keyproof_seed_test.go): an
# original card holding one of each seeded key family — an activated ability
# (A:AB$), a triggered ability (T:), a continuous static (S:) and a
# replacement effect (R:) — so the seed covers every family, not just cast.
# Not a Forge script: the licence guard keeps real corpus scripts out of this
# repository, and this file sits outside any cardsfolder/.
Name:Matrix Warden
ManaCost:2 U
Types:Creature Human Wizard
PT:2/2
A:AB$ Pump | Cost$ Tap | ValidTarg$ Creature | NumAtt$ +1 | NumDef$ +1 | SpellDescription$ Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
T:Mode$ ChangesZone | Origin$ Any | Destination$ Battlefield | ValidCard$ Matrix Warden | Execute$ TrigDraw | TriggerDescription$ When Matrix Warden enters the battlefield, draw a card.
S:Mode$ Continuous | Affected$ Creature | Subtype$ Human | AddPower$ 1 | Description$ Other Humans you control get +1/+1.
R:Event$ DamageDone | ReplaceWith$ ReplaceNullify | Continuous$ True | SourceType$ Spell | Description$ If a spell you control would deal damage, prevent that damage.
SVar:TrigDraw:DB$ Draw | Defined$ You | NumCards$ 1
SVar:ReplaceNullify:DB$ DealDamage | Defined$ You | Num$ 0
